io.name: clk
io.description: Clock input; all state updates occur on the rising edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset. When asserted at a rising edge, the FSM returns to the initial state and start_shifting is cleared to 0.

io.name: data
io.description: Serial input bit stream sampled on each rising edge of clk.

io.name: start_shifting
io.description: Output flag. Set to 1 (and held at 1) once the sequence 1101 has been detected in the input stream. Cleared only by reset.

functional_summary.overview: Finite-state machine that monitors a serial input bit stream for the pattern 1101. Upon detection, start_shifting is asserted and latched to 1 permanently until a synchronous active-high reset clears the FSM. Reset takes priority over all other behavior.
rules: On a rising edge of clk with reset asserted, the FSM enters the initial state (no bits matched) and start_shifting is set to 0.
On a rising edge of clk with reset deasserted, the FSM samples data and advances according to the pattern-matching state transitions for the target sequence 1101.

State transitions (reset deasserted): from S0 (no match) data=1 -> S1, else S0; from S1 (matched '1') data=1 -> S2, else S0; from S2 (matched '11') data=0 -> S3, else S2; from S3 (matched '110') data=1 -> S4 (matched '1101'), else S0.
When the FSM reaches the matched state S4, start_shifting is set to 1 on that same rising edge (one-cycle latency from the sampling edge that completes the pattern).
Once start_shifting is 1, it remains 1 on all subsequent rising edges regardless of data, until reset is asserted.
start_shifting is a registered output updated on the rising edge of clk; it reflects the state after the sampled edge settles.
